xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4280: Type and go: start a conversation or terminal from Home with no project, and fix Simple/Advanced defaulting

plan.title: Type and go: start a conversation or terminal from Home with no project, and fix Simple/Advanced defaulting
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator already split the type-and-go program into three sibling issues (#4280, #4281, #4282); this is Slice A, the smallest coherent vertical slice. Its ~40 files are mostly new small modules under components/home/ and their co-located tests; production edits outside those are one- to ten-line changes in existing files. Splitting further would separate the composer from the terminal hand-off it depends on and leave an unusable Home.

narratives.Problem: A fresh install shows Simple Home only on the first load: initialMode() in uiMode.ts never saves its answer and App writes overdeck:last-tab on every load, so load 2 resolves Advanced. Neither Home can start a conversation or terminal without a project even though the server can (getDefaultCwd); Simple Home's TalkItThrough only starts a discuss-then-file conversation and Advanced Home has no input. The Command Deck hides the No-project deck until an unscoped conversation exists, and the deck Launcher's 'Run in terminal:' row opens a dead pane and drops the typed text.
narratives.Proposal: Save the resolved UI mode on first load. Build a HomeComposer from the existing Launcher and mount it on both Homes: Enter asks the default agent the raw text, Ctrl+Enter runs it in a terminal, Simple adds 'Talk it through first:', and a project chip defaults to no project when none exist. Carry typed terminal commands through a sessionStorage hand-off that Stage and TerminalDrawer consume, and let POST /api/terminals type a single-line command into the new shell. Always show the No-project deck, select it when zero projects exist, fix the deck Launcher's terminal row, add a Move-to-project chip on unscoped conversations, and document it all.
narratives.NonGoals:
- The Add-project modal dialog, repo-root snapping, nested-repo import, repo suggestions, and the New Workspace Smart field (Slice B, #4281)
- The first-run 'Get set up' checklist, /api/prerequisites auth/backend/memory additions, and pan install / pan doctor changes (Slice C, #4282)
- CLAUDE.md and docs/WORKSPACES-AND-PROJECTS.md project-creation doc changes (Slice B)
- Memory-governor thresholds or macOS memory accounting (PAN-4267)
- A Herdr-backed ad-hoc terminal; the terminal drawer stays on tmux
- A first-launch preferences wizard
- Native OS folder picker or folder drag-and-drop
- Global quick-create shortcuts (PAN-701)
- Any edit to src/lib/tmux.ts or src/dashboard/frontend/src/App.tsx
- Moving existing Advanced users to Simple
- A web-search intent on Home

autoDecisions.summary: Scope W13 docs to Slice A surfaces only (quickstart.mdx, features/conversations.mdx, DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md, TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md, strings.ts comment); drop CLAUDE.md and WORKSPACES-AND-PROJECTS.md edits and the 'Get set up' card mention.
autoDecisions.rationale: The shared-context comment says each slice updates the docs it touches; documenting the Add-project dialog, suggestions route, or checklist before #4281/#4282 ship would describe features that do not exist.

autoDecisions.summary: Carry only ACs for W1-W5 and W13; AC-6..AC-12 of the issue body belong to W6-W12 in the sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue title and description scope this issue to W1-W5 and W13.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Add a project…' in the composer chip navigates to /projects/new (pushState {tab:'project-new'} + popstate) instead of opening the W7 modal.
autoDecisions.rationale: The modal is Slice B (#4281); the full-page route exists today and #4281 swaps the handler.

autoDecisions.summary: codexAvailable comes from GET /api/prerequisites (checks[id='codex'].found) via the shared ['prerequisites'] query.
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the existing PATH-detection surface (system-prerequisites.ts:169) and SetupChecklistBanner already caches it under that key.

autoDecisions.summary: Harness display labels live in a new HOME_AGENT_LABELS map copied from ProviderManagementSection.tsx HARNESS_LABELS; the Settings file is not refactored.
autoDecisions.rationale: Surgical-change rule; the map is seven entries.

autoDecisions.summary: Terminal hand-off consumption is split: TerminalDrawer's bootstrap effect passes a pending command into its single create call, and a second effect (only when a real terminal exists) creates an extra terminal; a same-tab CustomEvent wakes an already-mounted drawer. Both consumers use the consuming take, so a hand-off runs exactly once.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's 'read it in createTerminalSession' leaves the already-open-drawer case (deck Launcher) dead and risks two sessions on a fresh drawer.

autoDecisions.summary: POST /api/terminals validates command before createSession and returns commandSent; a send-keys failure still returns 200 with commandSent:false.
autoDecisions.rationale: A rejected request should not leave an orphan tmux session, and a live shell is still useful if typing the command failed.

autoDecisions.summary: The Simple placeholder keeps the words 'in plain words' ('Ask for anything, or describe what you want built, in plain words…').
autoDecisions.rationale: usability-core-loop.spec.ts:88 asserts /plain words/; keeping the phrase avoids changing that assertion and keeps the plain-language promise.

autoDecisions.summary: TalkItThrough.tsx remains as a seedDiscussPrompt re-export; the component and its component tests are deleted.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body's W3 decision; keeps existing imports working.

autoDecisions.summary: The Move-to-project chip renders in Stage/panes/AgentPane.tsx, self-gated, with a ConversationPanel-header fallback if the flex wrapper breaks layout.
autoDecisions.rationale: AgentPane wraps every deck conversation and is 60 lines; ConversationPanel is 1524 lines near its allowlist ceiling.

autoDecisions.summary: CommandDeck/index.tsx must not grow past its origin/main count (1609); the empty state moves to DeckEmptyState.tsx.
autoDecisions.rationale: The file-size ratchet compares with origin/main; the 1612 allowlist row should not be consumed by this change.

autoDecisions.summary: Tests extend existing files (Launcher.test.tsx, launcherActions.test.ts, ProjectHome.test.tsx, Stage.test.tsx, Sidebar.test.tsx, AgentPane.test.tsx, HomePage.test.tsx, simple-pages.test.tsx) instead of creating __tests__ siblings the issue named.
autoDecisions.rationale: Those test files already exist at those paths.

autoDecisions.summary: New frontend tests are registered in root package.json test:frontend-subset in one trailing item.
autoDecisions.rationale: CI runs only listed frontend tests (conventions.md); the script is one shared line, so a single item avoids edit conflicts.

autoDecisions.summary: The Playwright spec home-type-and-go.spec.ts is authored by the work agent and executed by the test role in an isolated browser against a dashboard built from this branch.
autoDecisions.rationale: Port 3011 serves main's deployment build, so the work agent cannot exercise branch code there.
